content.title: About
content.content: Cereal, K's, plain is a dry whole‑grain cereal designed for quick breakfast preparation. The flakes have a neutral taste, making them a versatile base for fruit, nuts, milk or yogurt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cereal, K's, plain is made from whole wheat grains enriched with vitamins and minerals.
The flakes contain low amounts of sugar, suitable for reduced‑sugar diets.
The product is often used as a base for homemade granola bars and desserts.
Packaging is typically recyclable, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: The cereal provides sustained energy through slowly digestible carbs.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Enrichment with vitamins B1, B2 and B6 supports metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron contributes to hemoglobin formation and helps maintain energy levels.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Low saturated fat content makes the cereal suitable for heart‑healthy diets.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The product contains wheat, so it is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten intolerance.

items.title: Added sugar content
items.content: When sweetened with dried fruit or syrups, the overall sugar level can increase.

items.title: Potential additives
items.content: Some versions may contain artificial flavors; check the label if you are sensitive to additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour hot or cold milk over the flakes, add fresh fruit, berries, nuts or honey to taste. They can also be used in baking, as a base for granola, or blended into smoothies.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. After opening, use within 4‑6 weeks to maintain crispness.
